name: BeijingABT Networks Co.,Ltd.
summary: BeijingABT Networks Co.,Ltd. develops and provides visualized network security technology solutions in China. It develops and operates Security Platform Operation System (SPOS). The company also offers various network security products, including embedded security gateways, which include next-generation firewalls and network behavior management and auditing components; and virtualized security gateway products that are used in cloud computing and large data centers, as well as security management, full-flow security, data security, cloud security, and security services for network security defense control, network monitoring, and early warning. In addition, it provides SPOS-Base products, including converged application and deep security gateways, NFV virtual security resources pool, and intrusion detection and defense systems; SPOS-Trace products, such as policy and traffic visualization platform; SPOS-App products comprising data analysis and operation platform, Web app vulnerability scanning cloud platform, host security monitoring platform, ID authentication and content management, and cloud security controllers. Its technology solutions include VPN, situation awareness, and cloud security. The company's products are primarily used in operating-service networks, campus networks, Wi-Fi security operation, large-scale industrial Intranets, etc., as well as by network operators in the government, finance, telecom operator, education, enterprise, medical, and other industrial fields. BeijingABT Networks Co.,Ltd. was founded in 2007 and is based in Beijing, China.
